summary: Frontend smoke and responsive testing completed. Dashboard, metrics, outlet filtering, inventory search, item validation/save, Finance PO approval, and all five operational module feedback actions passed on desktop. Mobile dashboard renders, but its menu does not open navigation.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the visible mobile menu button does not reveal the sidebar, leaving all module navigation inaccessible at mobile width.

action_items: Wire the mobile-menu-button to open a responsive navigation drawer or sidebar and allow module selection on mobile.
MOCKED API: Inventory, purchase orders, receiving, stock out, stock opname, HPP, and flash cost currently use local browser demo state; no backend API integration was tested or observed.
critical_code_review_comments: The mobile-menu button has no onClick handler while the sidebar is display:none below 760px, creating a complete mobile navigation dead end.
The receiving, stock out, opname, HPP, and flash cost screens are placeholder empty modules rather than their specified workflows; current actions only show toast feedback.
seed_data_creation: Added one temporary in-browser item named Test olive oil during the UI test; it is not persisted and disappears on reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop core flows passed. Re-test mobile menu at 390x844 after the navigation drawer is implemented; verify each module remains selectable from the drawer. API integrations remain unimplemented/mocked.
rca of the issue: In App.js, mobile-menu-button is rendered without an onClick handler, while App.css hides .sidebar at max-width 760px and contains no open-drawer state or mobile sidebar override. Therefore the button cannot change the hidden navigation state.
